q: A file has a syntax error on its last line. What runs?
options: Everything up to the broken line
It depends on whether the error is in a function
why: The whole file is compiled to bytecode before anything executes. A syntax error means there is no bytecode, so there is nothing to run.

q: A file calls an undefined name on its last line. What runs?
options: Everything up to that line, then it fails there
Everything, with the bad line skipped
why: Only syntax is checked at compile time. A missing name is discovered when that instruction is reached.

q: Why does every project get its own virtual environment?
options: Because two projects can need different versions of the same library
why: Without one, installs land in a directory shared by everything on the machine, and the second project to need a different version breaks the first.
